description_en: Queries the backup snapshots that are created for anti-ransomware
description_zh: 查询防勒索备份快照信息
name: DescribeSnapshots

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the server.

You can call the [DescribeBackupPolicy](~~DescribeBackupPolicy~~) operation to query the UUIDs of servers
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的服务器的UUID。
调用[DescribeBackupPolicy](~~DescribeBackupPolicy~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the server resides.

If the Uuid parameter is not specified, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
服务器所在的地域。

如果未指定参数Uuid，则该参数需必填
parameters.name: machine_region

parameters.help_en: The name or IP address of the server
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的服务器的名称或IP地址
parameters.name: machine_remark

parameters.help_en:
The status of backup snapshots from which data can be restored. Valid values:

COMPLETE: complete
PARTIAL_COMPLETE: partial complete
parameters.help_zh:
可恢复快照状态列表。取值：
COMPLETE：已完成
PARTIAL_COMPLETE：备份部分成功
parameters.name: status_list

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The starting position of the query. If this parameter is left empty, the query starts from the beginning.

If you call the operation for the first time, you do not need to specify the parameter. The response to the first call contains the token that can be used for the second call. Each subsequent response contains the token that can be used for the next call
parameters.help_zh:
用来标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始。

第一次调用不用填写，会在返回结果中包含第二次调用时用的NextToken，之后每次调用返回结果中都有下一次调用时的NextToken
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The version of the anti-ransomware policy. Valid values:

1.0.0
2.0.0
parameters.help_zh:
防护策略的版本。取值：

1.0.0：表示防护策略的版本为1.0.0
2.0.0：表示防护策略的版本为2.0.0
parameters.name: api_version

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the server is an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance. Valid values:

true: yes
false: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否阿里云ECS主机。取值：

true：是
false：否
parameters.name: is_ali_yun_ecs

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page
Count.description_zh: 当前页面显示的备份快照信息的数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned page
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

NextToken.description_en: The token that is used to initiate the next call

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的备份快照信息的数量

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的备份快照信息的总数量

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Snapshots.description_en: An array that consists of the backup snapshots

items.description_en: The information about the backup snapshot

ActualBytes.description_en: The actual data amount of backup snapshots after duplicates are removed. Unit: bytes
ActualBytes.description_zh: 去重后快照实际数据量。单位为字节

ActualItems.description_en:
The actual number of backup objects.

This parameter is available only for file backup
ActualItems.description_zh:
快照实际项目数。

目前仅文件备份可用

BytesDone.description_en: The actual amount of data that is generated by incremental backup. Unit: bytes
BytesDone.description_zh: 增量备份的数据量。单位为字节

BytesTotal.description_en: The total data amount of the data source. Unit: bytes
BytesTotal.description_zh: 数据源总量。单位为字节

ClientId.description_en: This parameter is returned only if the value of the SourceType parameter is ECS_FILE. This parameter indicates the ID of the Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) agent
ClientId.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，该参数有效。表示备份客户端ID

ClientVersion.description_en: The version of the anti-ransomware agent

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the backup snapshot was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
CreatedTime.description_zh: 备份快照的创建时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

ErrorFile.description_en: The file that records the information about backup failures, including the information about partially completed backup tasks
ErrorFile.description_zh: 记录备份失败信息的文件，包含备份部分完成的信息

ExpireTime.description_zh: 快照过期时间戳。单位：毫秒
ExpireTime.title_en: 快照过期时间戳。单位：秒。
ExpireTime.title_zh: 快照过期时间戳。单位：秒。

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the ECS instance

ItemsDone.description_en:
The number of backup objects.

This parameter is available only for file backup
ItemsDone.description_zh:
备份项目数。

目前仅文件备份可用

ItemsTotal.description_en:
The total number of objects in the data source.

This parameter is available only for file backup
ItemsTotal.description_zh:
数据源项目总数。

目前仅文件备份可用

JobId.description_en: The ID of the backup task

ParentSnapshotHash.description_en: The hash value of the parent backup snapshot

Path.description_en: This parameter is returned only if the value of the SourceType parameter is ECS_FILE. This parameter indicates the path to the backup files
Path.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，该参数有效。表示备份的文件路径

Paths.description_en: This parameter is returned only if the value of the SourceType parameter is NAS. This parameter indicates the path to the backup files
Paths.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为NAS时，该参数有效。表示备份的文件路径

items.description_en: The path information about the backup snapshot

PlanId.description_en: The ID of the backup plan

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region in which backup snapshot is stored

Retention.description_en: The retention period of the backup snapshot

SnapshotHash.description_en: The hash value of the backup snapshot

SnapshotId.description_en: The ID of the backup snapshot

SourceType.description_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

ECS_FILE: ECS files
OSS: Object Storage Service (OSS) buckets
NAS: File Storage NAS file systems
OTS_TABLE: Tablestore instances
SourceType.description_zh:
数据源类型。取值范围：

ECS_FILE：ECS文件的备份快照。
OSS：阿里云OSS的备份快照。
NAS：阿里云NAS的备份快照。
OTS_TABLE：阿里云表格存储的备份快照

Status.description_en:
The status of backup tasks. Valid values:

COMPLETE: complete
PARTIAL_COMPLETE: partial complete
FAILED: failed
Status.description_zh:
备份快照任务的状态。取值范围：

COMPLETE：成功
PARTIAL_COMPLETE：部分成功
FAILED：失败

VaultId.description_en: The ID of the backup vault that stores the backup snapshot
VaultId.description_zh: 保存备份库快照的仓库ID
